title: Luncheon slice, meatless-beef, chicken, salami or turkey

content.title: About
content.content: Luncheon slice is a ready‑to‑eat meat deli product offered in meatless‑beef, chicken, salami and turkey versions. It is made from selected meat cuts, seasoned with a blend of spices and vacuum‑packed to preserve freshness. The slice is convenient for quick snacks, sandwiches or salads.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Luncheon slice is a staple in office cafeterias because it stays safe to eat without cooking for several days.
The meatless‑beef version was created for consumers avoiding red meat while still wanting the classic deli flavor.
Salami in this product follows traditional Italian curing methods with paprika and garlic.
Turkey provides a leaner alternative, making that variant lower in calories.
Each package is sealed in an airtight film, allowing refrigeration for up to 14 days.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: A typical serving delivers about 12 g of protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains vitamin B12, niacin and riboflavin, which are essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Meat variants provide dietary iron needed for oxygen transport in the blood.

items.title: Low in carbohydrates
items.content: The product has virtually no sugar, making it suitable for low‑carb diets.

items.title: Provides zinc
items.content: Zinc supports immune function and wound healing.

items.title: Meat allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to specific meat types.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Added salt is used for preservation, so people with hypertension should limit intake.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Certain variants may contain food preservatives that are not suitable for all consumers.

items.title: Heat treatment
items.content: Although ready to eat, the slice can be warmed to enhance flavor if desired.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Luncheon slice can be eaten straight from the pack, added to sandwiches, salads, wraps, or used in hot dishes such as omelets and casseroles.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 0–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 5–7 days. Discard if the product develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
